title: Cornea_mock_1
extract_protocol_ch1: Samples were lysed in 300µl TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen) and total RNA was extracted by phenol/chloroform extraction following manufacturer's protocol.
extract_protocol_ch1.1: All libraries were constructed using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit (Illumina) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Starting material: 1µg total RNA
